features.title: Landing page
features.user_visible_behavior: Display a landing page with product introduction, Login, and Get Started buttons. Login navigates to the login page; Get Started navigates to the sign-up page.
verification: Open the app and verify the landing page renders correctly.
Click Login and verify navigation to the login page.
Click Get Started and verify navigation to the sign-up page.
evidence: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter frontend build
Browser verification: / renders the requested headline and all four metrics
Browser verification: Login navigates to /login and Get started navigates to /signup
Responsive browser check at 390px: no horizontal overflow; all four metrics render
features.notes: Redesigned to the slate palette and full-width infrastructure feature layout in DESIGN.md. The auth destinations are lightweight placeholders for the separate login-page feature.

features.title: Login page
features.user_visible_behavior: Display a login box with email and password fields, a Login button, and the text "Don't have an account? Sign up" at the bottom. Sign up is an embedded link to the sign-up page.
verification: Open the login page and verify all elements render correctly.
Verify the Sign up link appears at the bottom of the login box.
Click Sign up and verify navigation to the sign-up page.
evidence: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter frontend build
Browser verification: /login renders email and password fields, Login button, and the sign-up prompt
Browser verification: Sign up navigates to /signup
Responsive browser check at 390px: no horizontal overflow
features.notes: Login screen UI and sign-up navigation are implemented. Authentication submission is not included in the stated feature behavior.

features.title: Sign up page
features.user_visible_behavior: Clicking Get Started on the landing page or Sign up on the login page navigates to the sign-up page. Display a sign-up box containing an email field, a Continue button, and the text "Already have an account? Sign in" at the bottom. Sign in is an embedded link to the login page.
verification: Click Get Started on the landing page and verify navigation to the sign-up page.
Click Sign up on the login page and verify navigation to the sign-up page.
Verify the sign-up box contains only an email field and a Continue button.
Verify the text "Already have an account? Sign in" appears at the bottom of the box.
Click Sign in and verify navigation to the login page.
Verify the page renders correctly at supported viewport sizes.
evidence: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter frontend build
Browser verification: Get started navigates to /signup
Browser verification: /signup contains one email field, no password field, and Continue button
Browser verification: Sign in navigates to /login
Responsive browser check at 390px: no horizontal overflow
features.notes: Signup page matches the specified email-only entry screen. Continue is present as requested; account creation and OTP steps are outside this feature's specified behavior.

features.title: OTP verification page
features.user_visible_behavior: After submitting an email on the sign-up page, the user sees a success message confirming that an OTP has been sent and is redirected to the OTP verification page. The page displays an OTP input field and a Continue button. Invalid or expired OTPs display an error message below the input field. Successful verification redirects the user to the main app page without displaying an error message.
verification: Enter an email on the sign-up page and click Continue.
Verify a success message confirms that the OTP has been sent.
Verify redirection to the OTP verification page.
Enter an invalid or expired OTP and verify an error message appears below the input field.
Enter a valid OTP and click Continue.
Verify successful verification redirects to the main app page without an error message.
evidence: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter frontend build
Browser flow verification with mocked auth API: email request shows OTP-sent success message and navigates to /verify-otp
Browser flow verification: invalid OTP displays the server error below the code field
Browser flow verification: valid OTP stores signup token and redirects to /
Responsive browser check at 390px: no horizontal overflow
features.notes: Signup OTP request and verification use the existing backend routes through the frontend auth API layer. Success redirects to the existing root page because no separate main-app route currently exists.
